description: Seventh-round conservative temporal backfill candidates for remaining Canada and global research_temporal_dates gaps after round6. This report is research-only and is not merged into temporal overrides.
scope_notes: Input records were checked against data/reports/military_base_temporal_priority_queue.json and data/reports/military_base_temporal_remaining_gap_classes.csv.
Included source_ids are exact overlay feature identifiers from webapp/static_public/data/map_overlays/military_bases.geojson.
Included source_ids were checked against webapp/static_public/data/map_overlays/military_base_temporal_overrides.json and were not present there at generation time.
For declassified imagery-index records, start_year is a conservative documented-by year and not an inferred original construction year.

candidates.name: Nicolet Range

operational_intervals.label: DND Munitions Experimental Test Centre Nicolet firing-range impact-area phase

source_notes.title: Groupe S.M. International Awarded Contract - Canada.ca
source_notes.note: Canada.ca says the former Nicolet firing range was operated by DND's Munitions Experimental Test Centre - Nicolet from 1952 to 1999.

source_notes.title: Marking of Former Firing Range - Canada.ca
source_notes.note: DND UXO notice repeats that the southern portion of Lake Saint-Pierre was used by DND from 1952 to 1999 for METC reliability tests at Nicolet.

candidates.rationale: Exact Nicolet Range overlay row with two Canada.ca/DND sources providing the same operating interval. No open endpoint is used because the public DND sources identify the lake impact-area use as former.

candidates.name: Winona Range

source_notes.title: Canadian Armed Forces Training Area Winona Range and Training Area Upgrades - Impact Assessment Agency of Canada
source_notes.note: The 2017 federal notice identifies the CAFTA Winona Range and Training Area upgrade project and says DND intended to improve range infrastructure for future training requirements.

candidates.rationale: The source directly names Winona Range and Training Area as a Canadian Armed Forces training area in a federal assessment notice. Because no earlier origin date was found, the candidate uses the 2017 public project date as a conservative operational/documented-by start.

candidates.name: St. Charles Range

source_notes.title: Lest We Forget DO NOT PAY MARCH
source_notes.note: Local veterans/history newsletter text says St Charles Range was donated to the Department of National Defence in 1911 by Sir Henry Pallot.

candidates.rationale: The overlay row is the St. Charles Range. The 1911 DND donation date is direct temporal evidence for military range status; endpoint is left open because no sourced closure date was found.

candidates.name: Bedford Range

operational_intervals.label: Bedford Rifle Range / CFB Halifax range phase; start rounded to early-1900s evidence

source_notes.title: Our History - Nova Scotia Rifle Association
source_notes.note: NSRA history refers to ROSS rifles used by NSRA members on the Bedford Range in the early 1900s and discusses Canadian military/civilian marksmanship context.

source_notes.title: Microsoft Word - 102-5-8-Listing of City of Halifax Agreements
source_notes.note: Halifax agreement inventory lists Department of National Defence and Canadian Forces Base Halifax agreements for the Bedford Rifle Range.

source_notes.title: FCSAP Annual Report 2007-08 - Canada.ca
source_notes.note: Federal contaminated-sites report lists a Department of National Defence Marlant Bedford Rifle Range remediation/risk-management project.

candidates.rationale: The overlay row is the Bedford Range. The start is rounded to 1900 because the best public historical source says early 1900s rather than a precise establishment year, while later municipal and federal records confirm DND/CFB Halifax range identity.

candidates.name: Lethbridge Range

source_notes.title: Facility Report - National Pollutant Release Inventory
source_notes.note: Government of Canada NPRI report identifies a Department of National Defence military small-arms range used primarily by Reserve Force units on weekends at Lethbridge-area coordinates for report year 2013.

candidates.rationale: The source provides direct DND range-use evidence for the Lethbridge area but not an original establishment date. The candidate therefore uses 2013 as a conservative documented operational year.

candidates.name: Moncton Range

source_notes.title: Place names - Moncton Range - Natural Resources Canada
source_notes.note: Natural Resources Canada identifies Moncton Range as a National Defence-sourced range feature.

source_notes.title: New Brunswick - Canadian Military History
source_notes.note: The Moncton military history entry says a large military supply base was constructed in 1940 and that the rifle range continued to be used until the early 1980s.

candidates.rationale: The range name is exact, and NRCan confirms National Defence sourcing. The 1940 start is tied to the local military-base buildout and the end is rounded to 1982 because the source only gives early-1980s range closure.
